notes: Version 1.0.265 — PDF thumbnails, DMDE lists from Mac and Linux partitions, more accurate folder counting.
changelog: PDF thumbnails: the first page of each PDF document is shown in the report next to photo, RAW and video thumbnails.
DMDE file lists from Mac and Linux partitions (APFS, HFS+, ext) are recognised, and the report shows each file's modification date from DMDE.
Folder reporting skips folder links (junctions, symbolic links) — the same files are no longer counted several times and the numbers match Windows.
HTML report: the language flags are folded into one compact list, so the statistics bar stays on one line.
